infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Untangled Life reads your calendar to find time you and your partner are both free.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Untangled Life reads and adds events to your calendar so shared plans land on both your phones.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Untangled Life does not use reminders, but iOS groups this permission with calendars.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Untangled Life needs access to pick the photo you choose for your profile picture or your shared cover image. It only ever receives the picture you select.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Untangled Life uses Face ID to unlock the app, so a borrowed or lost phone doesn't show your shared diary.
